claims.claim: Scrap LG monitor and keyboard available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report shows an LG flat-screen monitor and a full-size desktop keyboard on the desk.
Witness notes dust/marks and no clear cracks, but no power-on test or functional check is shown to confirm 'scrap' status.

risks.risk: Monitor may be non-working or have display faults (dead pixels, backlight failure, burn-in) that are not visible in a non-powered photo.
risks.proof: A short video clip powering on the monitor showing a desktop/solid color test (white/black) and checking for dead pixels/backlight uniformity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly not working (worst case for a monitor).

risks.risk: Keyboard may have missing/sticky keys or non-functional keys; photo-only inspection can’t confirm key functionality.
risks.proof: A video clip typing through the full keyboard (including function keys and number row) and showing all keys respond (e.g., in a text editor).
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-tested/possibly partially faulty keyboard.

risks.risk: Missing cables/accessories (power cable, HDMI/VGA cable) could prevent use.
risks.proof: Photos showing included items: monitor power cable and the exact video cable type (HDMI/VGA/DVI) plus keyboard cable/USB.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'no accessories included' until cables are confirmed.

risks.risk: The two circular metal/black-ring items may be unrelated parts or could indicate the monitor/keyboard are being bundled with other scrap; buyer may not receive what they expect.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo identifying those items and confirming whether they are included with the monitor/keyboard or separate.
risks.if_unproven: Price as monitor+keyboard only, ignoring uncertain extra items.

risks.risk: Physical condition issues on the monitor (ports damage, stand parts missing, bezel cracks not visible) could affect usability.
risks.proof: Photos of the monitor back/ports and the stand/hinge area, plus a close-up of any damage around connectors.
risks.if_unproven: Price as 'may have minor damage/parts missing' until back/ports are shown.

proof_requests: Power-on video of the LG monitor showing a desktop and a dead-pixel/backlight check (white/black screens).
Video showing the keyboard connected and all keys working (type test in a text editor).
Photos of included cables: monitor power cable and the correct video cable (HDMI/VGA/DVI), plus keyboard connection type/cable.
Close-up photos of the monitor back/ports and stand/hinge area to confirm no missing parts or connector damage.
Clear identification of the two circular metal items: confirm whether they are included and what they are.
response.reason: A worst-case price can’t be set confidently because the key functional proof (power-on display and keyboard key testing) is missing; photos alone can’t confirm whether the items are actually working or fully scrap.
